R146_microbenchmark.provenance: Hashes match current committed source; assignment did not itself list these hashes.
R146_microbenchmark.current_dequant_reference: Current nativebatch0 uses individual dequant wrappers. Grouped APIs are a separate conditional benchmark arm; do not label them current production execution.
R146_microbenchmark.event_timing: Kernel-event duration excludes separate transfers. A copy-event duration measures that command interval, not necessarily the complete host-pack/PCIe service.

R147_memory.correction: R147 50.885GiB subtotal assumes context65536 and shrinks the hostKV. Current context262144 allocates full6.1875GiB even for64K prompt; corrected known subtotal is55.525GiB. No64GB-host fit claim applies to this125.715GiB host.

R148_route_scope.explicit_unsupported_compact_request: Prefill::init returns an error before allocation when explicit compact opt-in is incompatible; it does not silently turn the request off.
R148_route_scope.short_prompt_clipping: Prompt-length clipping belongs to the known-prompt one-shot initialization route. Serve allocates fixed chunk storage before GEN; short requests use tails without changing the6144 chunk limit.
R148_route_scope.ring: Owned stage buffers clamp to16; fullstream uses16 and routed consumers use the requested8. Do not label every consumer16.
R148_route_scope.quality_permission: The report suggestion to request a numeric threshold creates no approval requirement. Existing authorization covers measurement; evaluate observed deltas and retain unresolved quality claims.
